header.name: Create Load Form
header.description: Use this screen as a popup form for a user to enter details about a load

editor.elementName: Save Button which saves form data.

props.label: Sequence
props.description:
The load sequence - meaning, if the load must be handled in FIFO basis, the shipments for the load must be organized that way as well. using this sequence field.

Drag rows to reorder them and change their sequence value.

Lower numbers are presumed to be loaded ahead of larger numbers.

This correlates to the stop sequence, but in reverse order.

props.label: Shipment Lines
props.description: Number of shipment lines (different products/lots) in this shipment

props.label: Id
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

props.label: Estimated Weight (lbs)
props.description: The estimated weight in pounds (lbs) of the shipment, NOT INCLUDING packaging, pallets, handling units, etc.

props.label: Note
props.description: Details about this load specifically that may be seen when setting up picks for the inventory for this load

props.label: Line #
props.description: The line number for this product in the shipment. Order doesn't matter.

props.label: Product Code
props.description: The product code for this product to be shipped

props.label: Product Name
props.description: The name of the product to be shipped.

props.label: Quantity Allocated
props.description: The total quantity of this product to ship in this shipment.

props.label: Estimated Weight (lbs)
props.description: The estimated weight in pounds (lbs) of the shipment, NOT INCLUDING packaging, pallets, handling units, etc.

props.label: Order Line Number
props.description: Corresponding order line that this shipment line fulfills.

props.label: Adjust Allocations
props.description: Click to edit the amount of each corresponding order line release to fulfill with this shipment line. Defaults to full quantity of the order line release.

props.label: Trailer Number
props.description: An identifier for the physical trailer, typically given by the carrier (UPS, FedEx, etc.) in addition to other tracking-related information.
